subgraph.name: Flow Advect Loop
subgraph.description: Advects any gray pattern along a curl-noise flow field with two-phase loop-safe blending (uv.flow). Cycles are whole numbers, so the result loops seamlessly. Use for fire, smoke and magic motion.

exposed.label: Flow strength
exposed.tooltip: Distance a pixel travels per cycle.

exposed.label: Loop cycles
exposed.tooltip: Whole advection cycles per loop (integer = seamless).

exposed.label: Field evolution
exposed.tooltip: Animate 0 -> 1 per loop for a field that morphs and loops.

exposed.label: Phase noise
exposed.tooltip: Per-pixel phase offset hides the cross-fade pulse.

subgraph.name: Domain Warp
subgraph.description: Warps any gray pattern through a multi-octave noise vector field (domain warping): cauliflower edges, rolled smoke, organic flames. Animate Evolution 0 -> 1 for a looping warp.

exposed.label: Evolution
exposed.tooltip: Animate 0 -> 1 per loop for a seamless loop.

subgraph.name: Dissolve Over Time
subgraph.description: Dissolve / erode with burn edge: Shape + Noise in, Mask, Edge and a coloured Burn ramp out. Animate Progress 0 -> 100% (or Reverse to grow). Per-pixel, tiling-safe.

exposed.label: Noise amount
exposed.tooltip: How much the noise breaks the front.

exposed.label: Burn intensity
exposed.tooltip: HDR multiplier of the burn colour.

subgraph.name: Fire Temperature Ramp
subgraph.description: Gray temperature map -> HDR blackbody fire colour (core above 1, cool tips fade). A shape-curve control reshapes the input before the Kelvin mapping.

exposed.label: Shape curve
exposed.tooltip: Power on the input: > 1 pushes the body towards red.

subgraph.name: Soft Particle Mask
subgraph.description: Round soft-edged sprite mask (glow dot) with an adjustable falloff curve: the base sprite of embers, motes, glows and soft particles.

exposed.label: Size
exposed.tooltip: Disc size relative to the image.

subgraph.name: Lightning Bolt Core
subgraph.description: Lightning bolt with branches, strike reveal and a bloom pass. Animate Evolution for a morphing bolt, Seed (stepped) for flicker, Reveal for the strike.

exposed.label: Evolution
exposed.tooltip: Integer values return to a fresh shape.

subgraph.name: Rune Ring
subgraph.description: Procedural rune ring with border circles and bloom, ready for magic circles. Animate Rotation (360 per loop) and Reveal (build-up).

subgraph.name: Smoke Puff Body
subgraph.description: Billowy smoke / fireball body: warped billow noise multiplied by a soft round envelope and soft-thresholded into rolled edges. Animate Evolution for the roll, Size for the expansion.

exposed.label: Puff size
exposed.tooltip: Animate for the expansion (scale over life).

subgraph.name: Slash Color Rig
subgraph.description: Colour rig for slashes and swipes: Mask + Edge in, HDR colour out through two editable gradients. The three variants below are this rig with Fire / Ice / Arcane gradients.

exposed.label: Body gradient
exposed.tooltip: Colour of the slash body over the mask (HDR stops allowed).

exposed.label: Edge intensity
exposed.tooltip: HDR multiplier of the edge glow.

subgraph.name: Slash Color - Fire
subgraph.description: Fire variant of the Slash Color Rig (orange body, white-yellow edge).

exposed.label: Body gradient
exposed.tooltip: Colour of the slash body over the mask (HDR stops allowed).

exposed.label: Edge intensity
exposed.tooltip: HDR multiplier of the edge glow.
